mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing a lovely, mainly clear evening with a temperature of 83 degrees at Verona Community Park. Later tonight at 10:19 PM, keep an eye on the skies under our waxing crescent moon for a highly visible, five-minute ISS space station pass traveling from the Northwest to the East.

In city updates, Verona is highlighting local sustainability efforts. If you are an apartment resident interested in composting, the city recommends using private collection services or dropping off food scraps at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located at 1220 East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city continues to improve local energy efficiency by partnering with Alliant Energy to replace streetlights along East and West Verona Avenue with power-saving LEDs.

Looking ahead at local events, this Saturday, July 18th, features the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square, the Mount Horeb Art Fair, and live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Also, mark your calendars for next Wednesday, July 22nd, for Verona's own Downtown Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park.

For this week's police report, on Thursday, July 10th, officers and K9 Drea conducted a traffic stop for an equipment violation, which led to K9 Drea alerting officers to marijuana in the vehicle and the subsequent citation of a Beaver Dam woman.

To wrap things up, today's mouth-watering Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie, and they are open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you several hours to stop by. If you miss it, tomorrow's featured flavor will be sure-to-be delicious flavor will be Turtle.
